- issue: Cannot switch project or leave the page | steps:; - The project bar and the Shot Editor and Analysis buttons are locked while a storyboard video is generating; wait for it to finish.
commonProblems:
- problem: Scene lengths do not add up to the clip length | whyItHappens: The scenes total more or less than 5s or 10s. | howToFix: Click Fit to on the warning to rescale the scenes, or edit the lengths.

chunks.title: Storyboard — Problems and limits
chunks.text:
Storyboard (/studio/storyboard). Problems and limits.
- problem: Sketch rejected | whyItHappens: The file is not an image or is over 2.5 MB. | howToFix: Use a smaller image file (the message says 'That sketch is too large (2.5 MB at most).').
- problem: Character looks different between frames | whyItHappens: The character was not tagged on the scene or has no reference image. | howToFix: Open Shot Editor, click the character name under the scene to tag it, and add a reference image to the character.
- problem: Reference image upload fails | whyItHappens: The file type is not PNG, JPEG or WebP, or the upload failed. | howToFix: Use one of those types or paste an image URL into the reference field.
limitations:
- Generating frames or the storyboard video needs an active plan and your keys
- Clip length is 5s or 10s
- Aspect ratio is 16:9 or 9:16
- Sketch is not saved and is limited to 2.5 MB
- Projects are stored in this browser
- The storyboard video uses one character reference image
limitationDetails:
- limitation: Generating frames or the storyboard video needs an active plan and your keys | impact: Generate Storyboard shows 'An active plan is required to generate storyboards.' without a plan; frames need your MuAPI key, OpenAI Images frames need your OpenAI key. | workaround: Check your plan and open the API keys settings to check your keys.

chunks.title: Storyboard — Problems and limits
chunks.text:
Storyboard (/studio/storyboard). Problems and limits.
- limitation: Clip length is 5s or 10s | impact: The storyboard video cannot be longer than 10 seconds. | workaround: Split a longer story into several projects.
- limitation: Aspect ratio is 16:9 or 9:16 | impact: Square or other formats are not offered. | workaround: Crop in another studio after sending.
- limitation: Sketch is not saved and is limited to 2.5 MB | impact: After a reload the sketch has to be added again. | workaround: Re-upload the sketch before regenerating.
- limitation: Projects are stored in this browser | impact: Clearing site data or using another browser loses them. | workaround: Click JSON to keep a backup copy.
- limitation: The storyboard video uses one character reference image | impact: Only the first character that has a reference image is sent with Generate Storyboard. | workaround: Use frames (Frame) for per-character consistency.
faqs:
- question: Where do I open Storyboard? | answer: From the studio list, at /studio/storyboard. It opens on the Storyboard page; Shot Editor and Analysis are reached with buttons in 2. Scenes.
- question: Does Storyboard still have episodes? | answer: No. The current screens work with a project, a brief, scenes and characters; there is no episode screen.
- question: How long can the clip be? | answer: CLIP LENGTH offers 5s and 10s only.
- question: Which aspect ratios can I use? | answer: 16:9 and 9:16.

chunks.title: Storyboard — Problems and limits
chunks.text:
Storyboard (/studio/storyboard). Problems and limits.
- question: How do I draw a frame for a scene? | answer: Open Shot Editor and click Frame on the scene; the button becomes Regenerate once a frame exists.
- question: What is the difference between MuAPI and OpenAI Images? | answer: MuAPI uses the image model picked with the model button at the top right of Shot Editor. OpenAI Images uses an OpenAI image model chosen in a drop-down, adds Panel detail, Edit and Sketch, and uses your own OpenAI key from Settings.
- question: How do I change an existing frame? | answer: Switch FRAME ENGINE to OpenAI Images, then type the change into the Change this frame box and click Edit.
- question: How big can a sketch be? | answer: 2.5 MB at most, and it must be an image file.
- question: Can I export an animated GIF? | answer: Yes. In Shot Editor, set seconds per frame (0 uses each scene's own length) and click Export GIF. It needs at least one generated frame.
- question: How do I get a PDF? | answer: Click PDF at the top right of the Storyboard page; a print dialog opens where you can choose the PDF option.
- question: Where are my projects saved? | answer: In this browser. Use JSON to keep a backup file.
- question: Can I send the storyboard to another studio? | answer: Yes, with Send to you can continue in Video Studio, Cinema Studio or VFX Studio.

chunks.title: Marketing Studio — Overview
chunks.text:
Marketing Studio (/studio/marketing). Overview.
description: Creates a short video ad from your ad script, a product image, an optional avatar image, optional reference images and a video format preset.
shortDescription: Write an ad script, add your product image (and optionally an avatar), pick a format, and launch a short video ad.
fullDescription: Marketing Studio generates a short video ad. You type an ad script, upload a product image (required), and optionally add an avatar (your own image or one of eight presets) and up to six reference images. You also choose a video format preset (UGC, Tutorial, Unboxing, Hyper Motion, Product Review or TV Spot), an aspect ratio, a resolution (720p or 1080p) and a duration between 4 and 15 seconds. Click "Launch" and the finished video opens full screen and is added to the gallery on the same page, where you can download it, post it to social or delete it.
bestFor: Marketers and sellers who need quick short ad videos from a product image.
whenToUse:
- You want a short video ad from a script and a product image
- You want a presenter avatar in the ad
- You want to try different ad styles
whenToUseAnother:
- Use Video Studio for general video generation with model choice
- Use Lip Sync Studio to make an avatar speak recorded audio
- Use Image Studio to create or edit the product picture first
businessValue: Turns a script and a product image into a short video ad without filming.

chunks.title: Marketing Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Marketing Studio (/studio/marketing). How to use.
howToUse: 1. Open Marketing Studio at /studio/marketing (the "Marketing Studio" tab in the studio tab bar). The controls are in the bar at the bottom of the page. 2. Type your ad script in the large text box (placeholder "Describe your ad script... Use @image1 for product, @image2 for avatar."). Use @image1 to refer to the product image and @image2 to refer to the avatar image. 3. Upload your product image with the first round button in the row of upload buttons (tooltip "Upload Product"). You can click it to choose a file or drag an image onto it. A product image is required. 4. Optional: add an avatar. Either upload your own image with the second round button (tooltip "Upload Avatar"), or click the avatar button (it shows "Select Avatar" at first) and pick a preset from "Avatar Presets". Hover over a preset and click the magnifier ("Enlarge preview") to see it larger, then click "Select Avatar". 5. Optional: add up to six reference images with the third round button (tooltip "Upload References"); you can select several files at once. They appear as small round thumbnails above the text box; hover over one and click its x to remove it. 6. Optional: instead of uploading, click "Saved" to reuse images you uploaded or generated before. The first pick fills the product slot, the next the avatar slot, then the references. 7. Click the format button (it shows "UGC" at first) and choose a preset from "Video Format Presets": UGC, Tutorial, Unboxing, Hyper Motion, Product Review or TV Spot. 8. Choose the aspect ratio (9:16 at first, "Aspect Ratio" list), the resolution (1080p at first, "Resolution" list: 720p or 1080p) and the duration (5s at first, "Duration" list: 4s to 15s). 9. Click "Launch". The button shows "Generating..." while the ad is made. 10. When it is ready the video opens full screen; click outside it or the close button to return to the page. The ad is also added at the top of the gallery, where hover shows the actions: copy prompt, "Download", Post to social, an AI assist star and "Delete".

chunks.title: Marketing Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Marketing Studio (/studio/marketing). How to use.
howToSteps:
- Open Marketing Studio at /studio/marketing (the "Marketing Studio" tab in the studio tab bar). The controls are in the bar at the bottom of the page.
- Type your ad script in the large text box (placeholder "Describe your ad script... Use @image1 for product, @image2 for avatar."). Use @image1 to refer to the product image and @image2 to refer to the avatar image.
- Upload your product image with the first round button in the row of upload buttons (tooltip "Upload Product"). You can click it to choose a file or drag an image onto it. A product image is required.
- Optional: add an avatar. Either upload your own image with the second round button (tooltip "Upload Avatar"), or click the avatar button (it shows "Select Avatar" at first) and pick a preset from "Avatar Presets". Hover over a preset and click the magnifier ("Enlarge preview") to see it larger, then click "Select Avatar".
- Optional: add up to six reference images with the third round button (tooltip "Upload References"); you can select several files at once. They appear as small round thumbnails above the text box; hover over one and click its x to remove it.
- Optional: instead of uploading, click "Saved" to reuse images you uploaded or generated before. The first pick fills the product slot, the next the avatar slot, then the references.

chunks.title: Marketing Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Marketing Studio (/studio/marketing). How to use.
- Click the format button (it shows "UGC" at first) and choose a preset from "Video Format Presets": UGC, Tutorial, Unboxing, Hyper Motion, Product Review or TV Spot.
- Choose the aspect ratio (9:16 at first, "Aspect Ratio" list), the resolution (1080p at first, "Resolution" list: 720p or 1080p) and the duration (5s at first, "Duration" list: 4s to 15s).
- Click "Launch". The button shows "Generating..." while the ad is made.
- When it is ready the video opens full screen; click outside it or the close button to return to the page. The ad is also added at the top of the gallery, where hover shows the actions: copy prompt, "Download", Post to social, an AI assist star and "Delete".
gettingStarted:
- Open Marketing Studio from the studio tab bar or go to /studio/marketing.
- Write your ad script in the text box.
- Upload your product image (required).
- Optionally choose an avatar and a video format preset.
- Set aspect ratio, resolution and duration.
- Click "Launch" and wait for the video to open.
tips:
- Write @image1 where the product should appear and @image2 where the avatar should appear. Images are numbered in order: product first, then avatar, then references. If you skip the avatar, your first reference image takes the second position.

Marketing Studio (/studio/marketing). How to use.
- Try 720p and a short duration while testing; use 1080p when the script is final.

bestPractices:

- Reference the images by number in the script so the result knows which image is which.
- Upload images under 10MB; JPG, PNG and WEBP are accepted.

chunks.title: Body Swap — Overview
chunks.text:
Body Swap (/studio/recast). Overview.
description: Replaces the character in a video with a character from an image: you upload a source video and a character image, and the result is the new character performing the video's motion.
shortDescription: Upload a source video and a character image, then swap the character in the video with the one in your image.
fullDescription: Body Swap (the "Body Swap" tab, also called Recast Studio; the page title reads "BODY SWAP STUDIO") takes two uploads: a source video that supplies the movement and a character image that supplies the new look. You choose one of the models from a dropdown, optionally type a short description of the motion or scene, and click "Swap Body". Depending on the model you may also see an aspect ratio button or an Orientation button. The finished video is added to the gallery at the top of the page, where you can preview it, open it full screen, download it, post it to social or delete it. A "Library" button keeps the videos, images and results you used in this browser, and a "Saved" button reuses files saved from any studio.
bestFor: Creators who want to swap a character into existing footage.
whenToUse:
- You want to replace the person or character in an existing video
- You want a still character to perform a recorded movement
whenToUseAnother:
- Use Video Studio for general video generation
- Use Lip Sync Studio to change what a speaker says

chunks.text:
Body Swap (/studio/recast). Overview.

businessValue: Reuses existing footage by replacing who appears in it.

chunks.title: Body Swap — How to use
chunks.text:
Body Swap (/studio/recast). How to use.
howToUse: 1. Open Body Swap at /studio/recast (the "Body Swap" tab in the studio tab bar). The controls are in the bar at the bottom of the page. 2. Add the source video, the clip whose movement you want to keep: click the first round button (tooltip "Upload video file, or drag and drop"), choose a file, or drag a video onto it. Videos must be under 50MB. 3. Add the character image, the person or character who should appear instead: click the second round button (tooltip "Upload character image file, or drag and drop") or drag an image onto it. Images must be under 10MB. 4. To remove an upload, click its round button again (the file name shows with "click to clear" in the tooltip). 5. Click the model button (it shows the current model name) and choose from the "Model" list: Kling 3.0 Pro Motion Control (selected at first), Runway Act Two or Wan2.2 Animate. 6. If you chose Runway Act Two, an aspect ratio button appears; click it and pick a value from the "Aspect Ratio" list. If you chose Kling 3.0 Pro Motion Control, an "Orientation:" button appears; choose "Image" or "Video" from the "Orientation" list (see the tips below). 7. Optional: type a note in the text box (placeholder "Optional — describe the motion or scene..."). It is used only by Kling 3.0 Pro Motion Control and Wan2.2 Animate; Runway Act Two ignores it. 8. Click "Swap Body". The button shows "Swapping..." while the video is made. 9. When it finishes, the new video appears at the top of the gallery. Hover over it to preview, click it for full screen, and use the icons that appear on hover to copy the prompt, download ("Download"), post to social or delete ("Delete").

gettingStarted:

"Image" is selected at first. Use "Video" for videos longer than about 10 seconds.

chunks.title: Layers Studio — Overview
chunks.text:
Layers Studio (/studio/layers). Overview.
description: Canvas editor with a right-hand tools panel: split an image into layers, upscale, color grade, remove the background, expand the image, and run quick AI edits (Edit text, Enhancer, Relight, Angles).
shortDescription: Canvas editor with a right-hand tools panel: split an image into layers, upscale, color grade, remove the background, expand the image, and run quick AI edits (Edit text, Enhancer, Relight, Angles).
fullDescription: Layers Studio shows your image on a canvas, a floating toolbar and prompt bar at the bottom, and a Tools panel on the right. The panel opens on Layer Decomposition; use the back arrow (Back to Tools) to see the tool list: Layer Decomposition, Upscale, Color Grading, Remove background, Expand & Outpaint, Edit text, Enhancer, Relight and Angles. Each tool has its own action button at the bottom of the panel (for example 'Separate layers', 'Upscale', 'Remove Background', 'Expand Image'); there is no single 'Process' button. The studio starts with a sample image already loaded, so you can try it before uploading your own.
bestFor: Designers and marketers finishing and preparing images.
whenToUse:
- Splitting, upscaling, cutting out or expanding an image
- Quick color grading
whenToUseAnother:
- Use Image Studio to generate new images
- Use Edit Studio for single-purpose tool cards

chunks.title: Layers Studio — Overview
chunks.text:
Layers Studio (/studio/layers). Overview.
businessValue: Prepares images for production without leaving the studio.

chunks.title: Layers Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Layers Studio (/studio/layers). How to use.
howToUse: Open Layers Studio from the studio tab bar or go to /studio/layers. A sample image is already on the canvas. To use your own image, click the thumbnail button on the left edge (hover shows CHANGE, tooltip 'Upload or Change Image'), or click the + button in the prompt bar (tooltip 'Add Image'), or drop an image on the canvas. Images must be image files up to 20MB. You can also click Saved on the left to reuse an earlier image. In the Tools panel on the right, click the back arrow (tooltip 'Back to Tools') to see the list, then click the tool you want.
howToSteps:
- Open Layers Studio from the studio tab bar or go to /studio/layers. A sample image is already on the canvas.
- To use your own image, click the thumbnail button on the left edge (hover shows CHANGE, tooltip 'Upload or Change Image'), or click the + button in the prompt bar (tooltip 'Add Image'), or drop an image on the canvas. Images must be image files up to 20MB. You can also click Saved on the left to reuse an earlier image.
- In the Tools panel on the right, click the back arrow (tooltip 'Back to Tools') to see the list, then click the tool you want.

chunks.title: Layers Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Layers Studio (/studio/layers). How to use.
- Layer Decomposition: choose Resolution (1K, 1.5K or 2K) and drag the Layers slider (2 to 16). Optionally type instructions in the prompt bar at the bottom ('Describe how to edit image or split layers...'). Then click the lime button at the bottom of the panel that reads 'Separate layers' (the star button in the prompt bar, tooltip 'Run Layer Decomposition', does the same).
- Upscale: click the Model box and pick Topaz, SeedVR2 or AI Upscaler. For Topaz choose Upscale Factor x1, x2, x4 or x8; for SeedVR2 choose Resolution 2k, 4k or 8k; AI Upscaler has no extra options. Click the button that reads 'Upscale' followed by a number.
- Remove background: open Remove background and click 'Remove Background 1.0'. Expand: open Expand & Outpaint and click 'Expand Image 0.03'.
- Color Grading: open Color Grading and move the sliders in each section (Color Correct, Soften Details, Bloom, Halation, Lens Instructions, Exposure, Film Grain). Use a section's Reset button, the reset-all button (tooltip 'Reset All Color Grading'), Download to save the graded image, or Post to social.
- Edit text / Enhancer / Relight / Angles: open the tool and click its button (Run Text Edit, Enhance Image, Apply Relight, Apply Perspective Angle). Edit text has its own box 'Enter text modification prompt...'.

chunks.title: Layers Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Layers Studio (/studio/layers). How to use.
- Wait for the progress overlay ('Processing Image...') to finish. Upscale, Remove background, Expand and the quick edits replace the image on the canvas with the result.
- For layers, use the Layer Carousel: arrows (Previous Layer / Next Layer), the eye button (Toggle Visibility), Solo Active / Stack Mode, 'Save' for one layer, or 'Download All' for every layer.
gettingStarted:
- Open the Layers tab (/studio/layers).
- Click the sample image's thumbnail (left edge) to upload your own image, or keep the sample to try the tools.
- Pick a tool in the right panel (use the back arrow to see the list).
- Click the action button at the bottom of the panel.
- Download the result (Download All for layers, Save for one layer, Download in Color Grading).
tips:
- Click the sample card at the top of Layer Decomposition (tooltip 'Click to load this layer decomposition example') to load a ready-made 5-layer example without spending credits on a run.
- Use Lasso edit or Regional edit to mark an area, type a prompt in the floating bar ('Type your prompt here...') and press Enter; marked areas are also added as layer regions for the next decomposition (a 'Clear (N)' button removes them).
- Run Remove background first, then Upscale: the result of each tool becomes the image for the next one.
- Color Grading is applied on your device; download or post it from the Color Grading footer.

chunks.title: Layers Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Layers Studio (/studio/layers). How to use.
- The buttons show a number (for example 'Upscale 1.0', 'Expand Image 0.03', 'Remove Background 1.0'): these are fixed labels in the screen.
bestPractices:
- Use a clear image with distinct subjects before decomposing; raise the Layers slider only if you need more separate elements.
- Check the canvas result before running the next tool, because the canvas image is replaced.
- Download layers before you load another image or sample; uploading a new image clears the layer list.
- Keep source images under 20MB (PNG, JPEG, WEBP).

chunks.title: Layers Studio — Features

keyFeatures:

chunks.title: Workflows — Overview
chunks.text:
Workflows (/studio/workflows). Overview.
description: Browse template, personal and community workflows, run a workflow from a simple Playground form, or edit it on a node canvas (Full Workflow).
shortDescription: Open a workflow from Templates, My Workflows or Community, run it in the Playground, or build and edit it in the Full Workflow canvas.
fullDescription: The Workflows page has a list view and a workflow view. The list shows cards under three tabs: Templates, My Workflows and Community, with a Create Workflow button. Clicking a card opens the workflow, where two tabs let you either run it with a form (Playground) or open the node canvas (Full Workflow). In the Playground the form fields come from the workflow's own inputs, and the Run Workflow button shows the outputs as images, videos or text. In the canvas you add nodes, connect them, and use Run All, Publish and Save Workflow.
bestFor: People who want to chain generation steps and re-run them.
whenToUse:
- You want to reuse a multi-step generation recipe
- You want to run a template or community workflow with your own inputs
- You want to build a pipeline on a node canvas
whenToUseAnother:
- Use Image Studio or Video Studio for a single generation
- Use Agents for a chat-style assistant
businessValue: Lets a repeatable multi-step process be saved and re-run instead of repeating each step by hand.

chunks.title: Workflows — How to use
chunks.text:
Workflows (/studio/workflows). How to use.
howToUse: Open Workflows, pick a tab, click a workflow card (or Create Workflow). In Playground fill the Configuration fields and click Run Workflow; in Full Workflow edit the canvas and click Run All.
howToSteps:
- Open the Workflows tab (route /studio/workflows). You see the title 'Workflows' and the tabs Templates, My Workflows and Community.
- Click a tab: Templates for ready-made workflows, My Workflows for ones you created, Community for workflows others published. Each workflow is a card with a category and name. If a tab is empty you see 'No workflows found in this section.'
- Click a card to open it. The top bar shows All Workflows (back), the tabs Playground and Full Workflow, and the workflow name. Playground is the first view.
- In Playground, fill the fields under Configuration. Each field is named by the workflow's own input (text fields are boxes, choices are dropdowns); starting values or examples are filled in for you.
- Click Run Workflow. The button shows 'Generating...' and the right side shows 'Running Pipeline'. When it finishes you see 'Workflow Results' with a COMPLETED badge.
- Look at the result cards: images, videos (with controls) or text. Hover a card to reveal the output id and a link button that opens the file in a new tab.

chunks.title: Workflows — How to use
chunks.text:
Workflows (/studio/workflows). How to use.
- To change the workflow itself, click Full Workflow. The canvas opens; use the + button on the left, or right-click the canvas, to add nodes (Input Models, Text (LLMs), Generate Image, Edit Image, Generate Video, Edit Video, Generate Audio, Api Node, Utilities). The search box says 'Search nodes or models'.
- Connect nodes by dragging between their handles and set each node's fields. Click Run All at the top right to save and run the whole workflow (it shows the total cost in dollars when known).
- Click the workflow name at the top to open 'Save Workflow', type a name in 'Enter Workflow Name' and click Save. Use Publish (or Unpublish) to share or withdraw it.
- Click All Workflows to return to the list. To create a new one, click Create Workflow on the list page.
gettingStarted:
- Open Workflows from the studio tabs (route /studio/workflows).
- Start on the Templates tab and click a card that looks close to what you need.
- In Playground, fill in the Configuration fields.
- Click Run Workflow and wait for 'Workflow Results'.
- If you want to change the steps, click Full Workflow. For templates you do not own the canvas is locked and shows Duplicate, which makes your own copy.
- Use Create Workflow when you want to start from a blank 'Untitled Workflow'.
tips:
- Try a Template in Playground first to see what inputs and outputs look like.

chunks.title: Workflows — How to use
chunks.text:
Workflows (/studio/workflows). How to use.
- Use Rename (card menu on My Workflows) to give workflows clear names.
- Playground text fields for image or video inputs are plain text boxes: paste a link rather than choosing a file.
- If you use the top bar toggle Enter Zen Mode, the bar becomes a small floating pill with Play, Builder and Exit Zen.
- Run All saves the workflow before running it, so you do not need to save first.
bestPractices:
- Name each workflow clearly with Rename or Save Workflow before sharing it.
- Test in Playground before publishing.
- Duplicate a template instead of trying to edit it directly: a workflow you do not own cannot be edited.
- Check the cost shown next to Run All before running big workflows.
- Use Community to learn how other people connect nodes.

chunks.title: Workflows — Problems and limits
chunks.text:

- problem: Canvas is locked | whyItHappens: You are not the owner of the workflow. | howToFix: Click Duplicate.
- problem: Run Workflow button is disabled | whyItHappens: A run is in progress or the workflow has no id. | howToFix: Wait for the run to finish, or save the workflow first.
- problem: Output is plain text instead of an image | whyItHappens: The output type returned by the workflow is text. | howToFix: Check the workflow's output node in Full Workflow.

chunks.title: Agents — Overview
chunks.text:
Agents (/studio/agents). Overview.
description: A gallery of MuAPI-hosted AI agents: browse Templates, your own agents (My Agents) and your past conversations (My Chats), then open an agent to chat with it.
shortDescription: Browse agent cards under Templates, My Agents and My Chats, and open one to chat; use Create to make your own agent.
fullDescription: The Agents studio is a list page with a header called Agents, three tabs (Templates, My Agents, My Chats) and a Create button. Template and My Agents tabs show agent cards (picture or placeholder, category, name and, for community agents, 'By <owner>'). My Chats shows one card per past conversation with the agent name, chat title, how long ago it was updated and a message count. The agents themselves are hosted by MuAPI. Clicking an agent card opens that agent's own full-screen chat page (address /agents/<agent id>), which has a 'Back to Studio' link in the top-left corner. Create opens the agent creation page (/agents/create).
bestFor: Users who prefer asking an assistant over filling generation forms.
whenToUse:
- You want a chat-style assistant
- You want an agent with your own instructions
whenToUseAnother:
- Use Workflows to chain generation steps
- Use Design Agent AI to generate design assets from chat
- Use Image or Video Studio for single generations
businessValue: Gives a quick conversational helper and lets you save your own agent instructions.

chunks.title: Agents — How to use
chunks.text:
Agents (/studio/agents). How to use.
howToUse: Open Agents, choose Templates, My Agents or My Chats, click a card to open the chat, type a message and send it. Use Create to build a new agent.
howToSteps:
- Open the Agents tab (route /studio/agents). The header says Agents and shows the tabs Templates, My Agents and My Chats.
- Click Templates to see ready-made agents. Each card shows a category label (or 'AI Assistant' when none is set), the agent name and, for community agents, 'By <owner>'.
- Click a card to open that agent. The agent's chat page opens full screen; use 'Back to Studio' at the top-left to return.
- Type your message in the chat box and send it. In the chat view built into this studio the box says 'Message this agent...'; press Enter to send or Shift+Enter for a new line, or click Send. Agent replies are shown as formatted text.
- Wait for the reply (a spinner shows while the agent works; the studio waits up to about 5 minutes before showing 'Agent response timed out.').
- To continue an old conversation, click My Chats and click a conversation card; it opens the agent with that chat's history.
- To see agents you made, click My Agents.
- To make an agent, click Create (the + Create button at the top right). The create page opens. In the create form built into this studio the fields are Name, Description, System Prompt and 'Welcome Message (optional)', and the submit button is Create Agent.

chunks.title: Agents — How to use
chunks.text:

gettingStarted:
- Open Agents from the studio tabs (route /studio/agents).
- Stay on Templates and click an agent card that matches your task.
- Type a message and send it.
- Come back later through My Chats to continue the conversation.
- Click Create when you want your own agent with your own System Prompt.
tips:
- Use My Chats to continue a conversation instead of starting over.
- If a list fails to load click Retry.
- A card that has no picture shows a placeholder icon; the agent still works.
- The Welcome Message field is optional; when set it is shown at the start of an empty chat.
bestPractices:
- Try several template agents before creating your own.
- When you create an agent, put the role and rules into System Prompt (placeholder 'You are a helpful assistant that...').
- Give the agent a clear Name and short Description so you can find it in My Agents.
- Keep messages specific; the agent only sees what you type in the chat.

chunks.title: Design Agent AI — Overview
chunks.text:
Design Agent AI (/studio/design-agent). Overview.
description: A chat-based design assistant called Go-AI: describe what you want or pick a template, approve its plan, and get images, videos, audio or text assets back, with optional reference media and a Brand Kit.
shortDescription: Chat with Go-AI, optionally pick a template and attach references, approve the plan, and download the generated assets.
fullDescription: Design Agent AI opens on a home screen headed 'Design is easier with Go-AI'. A prompt box takes your request; beside it are a '+' button to upload reference media, a Templates pill, a reference counter (0/14 references) and a Send button. Under it, Recent Projects lists a New Project tile and your saved projects. Above the prompt are the mode pills (agent, generate, edit) and a Brand Kit button. Sending a message creates a project (if none is open) and starts a chat. Go-AI may first show an execution plan card with its steps and credit estimate; you press 'Approve & Generate' or 'Reject / Revise'. Results appear in the chat as asset thumbnails; click one to open a viewer with Download and image actions (Edit with Go-AI, Upscale, Remove BG, Vectorize, Enhance). The studio needs a paid SmartVideo GO plan; otherwise an upgrade prompt appears.
bestFor: Non-designers who want brand and marketing assets from a chat with templates.
whenToUse:
- You want design assets from a conversation

chunks.title: Design Agent AI — How to use
chunks.text:
Design Agent AI (/studio/design-agent). How to use.
howToUse: Open Design Agent AI, type what you want (or choose a template with Templates), optionally attach references and turn on Brand Kit, press Send, approve the plan if one appears, then click a result to download it or run an image action.
howToSteps:
- Open the Design Agent AI tab (route /studio/design-agent). Without a MuAPI key in place, sending, uploading or creating a project opens the API key window instead.
- You land on the home screen 'Design is easier with Go-AI'. Optionally click one of the mode pills at the top (agent, generate, edit); agent is selected at first.
- Optional: click the Brand Kit button, tick 'Use Brand Kit', fill the logo, colors, fonts, tone and style boxes, then click 'Save Brand Kit'. The Brand Kit button turns green while it is on.
- Optional: click Templates, search with 'Search templates...' and click a template card. A chip showing the template id (for example logo-design) appears next to the Templates button; click its x ('Clear template') to remove it.
- Optional: click the '+' button ('Upload reference media') and choose image, video or audio files. A counter shows how many of 14 references you used; 'Uploading reference…' appears while files upload, and each file shows as a chip you can remove.

chunks.title: Design Agent AI — How to use
chunks.text:
Design Agent AI (/studio/design-agent). How to use.
- Type your request in the prompt box (Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a new line). You can also send with only a template or only attachments selected.
- Click Send (the arrow button, 'Send message'). A project named 'Project 1', 'Project 2' and so on is created automatically if none is open, and 'Go-AI is planning' appears.
- If a plan card titled 'GO-AI EXECUTION PLAN' appears, read its steps and the credit total, then click 'Approve & Generate' to run it, or 'Reject / Revise' to cancel it (the prompt box is pre-filled with 'Revise the plan: ' for you to explain what to change).
- Wait while 'Go-AI is working...' is shown. Generated assets appear under Go-AI's reply.
- Click an asset to open the viewer. Click Download to save it; for images you can also click Edit with Go-AI, Upscale, Remove BG, Vectorize or Enhance. Edit with Go-AI, Upscale, Remove BG and Vectorize switch to edit mode, attach the image and prefill the prompt; you then press Send.
- Click '← Back' at the top-left of the chat to return to the home screen; your project is listed under Recent Projects.
gettingStarted:
- Open Design Agent AI from the studio tabs (route /studio/design-agent).
- Make sure you are signed in. SmartVideo GO access is included with your account; if it is not active, sending shows an upgrade prompt.

chunks.title: Design Agent AI — How to use
chunks.text:
Design Agent AI (/studio/design-agent). How to use.
- Type a simple request such as the one suggested by the typing placeholder (for example 'Ask Go-AI to create a thumbnail...').
- Press Send and wait for the plan or the result.
- Click 'Approve & Generate' if a plan card shows.
- Click a result and press Download.
tips:
- Use Templates to start from a ready-made recipe; you can still add your own text.
- Turn on Brand Kit before generating so your colors, fonts, tone and style are sent with each message.
- Attach reference images with the '+' button; they are listed in the chat with their labels.
- After an image is generated, use Upscale, Remove BG or Vectorize from the viewer instead of retyping a prompt.
- The placeholder text cycles through ideas such as 'Ask Go-AI to design a brand kit...' to show what you can ask.
bestPractices:
- Read the credit total on the plan card before pressing 'Approve & Generate'.
- Use 'Reject / Revise' and explain changes rather than starting over.
- Keep references to files that pass the upload check (see limits).
- Download results you want to keep; chat messages are not restored when you reopen a project.
- Fill all Brand Kit fields you care about; empty ones are sent as 'not set'.

chunks.title: Design Agent AI — Problems and limits
chunks.text:
Design Agent AI (/studio/design-agent). Problems and limits.
troubleshooting:
- If generation is blocked, open the API keys settings and check your MuAPI key.
- If an upgrade prompt appears, your account's SmartVideo GO access is not active. Sign in again or contact support.
- 'Error: ... Please check your API key.' appears in the chat when a request fails.
- 'Reference upload failed' or a size error means the file was refused.
- If no assets appear, read the activity lines above the prompt box for the error.
troubleshootingSteps:
- issue: Nothing happens when I press Send | steps:; - If generation is blocked, open the API keys settings and check your MuAPI key.; - Make sure the prompt box has text, a template chip or an attachment.; - If an upgrade prompt opens, sign in again; if it persists, contact support.
- issue: Upload fails | steps:; - Check the file is an image (jpg/png/webp), video (mp4/webm/mov) or audio (mp3/wav/webm).; - Check size: image 10 MB, video 50 MB, audio 10 MB.; - Try again with the '+' button.
- issue: Plan card is stuck | steps:; - Click 'Approve & Generate' to continue or 'Reject / Revise' to change it.; - Wait for 'Go-AI is working...' to finish.
- issue: My project chat is empty after reopening | steps:; - This is expected: only the project list is saved in the browser.; - Start a new request, and download assets you want to keep.

chunks.title: Design Agent AI — Problems and limits
chunks.text:
Design Agent AI (/studio/design-agent). Problems and limits.
- problem: Upgrade prompt appears | whyItHappens: The studio requires SmartVideo GO access. | howToFix: Activate access, then retry.
- problem: Image action did not generate anything | whyItHappens: The action only attaches the image and fills the prompt. | howToFix: Press Send.
- problem: Brand Kit seems ignored | whyItHappens: 'Use Brand Kit' is not ticked or fields are empty. | howToFix: Tick it and fill the fields.
limitations:
- Needs SmartVideo GO access (included for signed-in accounts). If it is not active, an upgrade prompt opens and messages like 'Payment required to use Design Agent' appear.
- Up to 14 reference files per message.
- Reference upload limits: images 10 MB, video 50 MB, audio 10 MB; accepted types are jpg/png/webp images, mp4/webm/mov video and mp3/wav/webm audio. Unsupported types are skipped without a message.
- Projects and the Brand Kit are saved in this browser only, and chat messages are not restored when you reopen a project.
- Only the 8 most recent projects are shown on the home screen.
- Polling for a job stops after 120 checks (about 4 minutes) and then shows the result or failure.
limitationDetails:
- limitation: SmartVideo GO access | impact: Sending, uploading and plan actions are blocked and an upgrade prompt opens. | workaround: Sign in again; if the prompt keeps appearing, contact support so your access can be checked.

- question: How many templates are there? | answer: The picker currently lists 30 templates (counted in DesignAgent.tsx) and has a search box.

- question: What files can I attach? | answer: jpg/png/webp images up to 10 MB, mp4/webm/mov video up to 50 MB, mp3/wav/webm audio up to 10 MB.

Design Agent AI (/studio/design-agent). Problems and limits.
- question: What does Approve & Generate do? | answer: It approves Go-AI's execution plan so it starts generating; 'Reject / Revise' cancels it and prefills 'Revise the plan: '.

chunks.title: VFX — Overview
chunks.text:
VFX (/studio/vfx-studio). Overview.
description: Turn one image into a short video with a chosen AI effect, camera move or VFX preset from a picture catalogue.
shortDescription: Turn one image into a short video with a chosen AI effect, camera move or VFX preset from a picture catalogue.
fullDescription: The studio page is titled AI VFX Studio. You add one source image, pick an effect card from the catalogue (three categories: AI Effects, Motion Controls and VFX), optionally describe the subject in a text box, choose Aspect, Duration, Size and Quality, and click Generate. The result is a short video that you can download, copy as a URL, post to social, enhance or regenerate. The effect list is a fixed catalogue of named presets: the preset name decides the look and anything you type is added on top.
bestFor: Creators and marketers who want fast, preset-driven effect clips from a single image.
whenToUse:
- Turn a single image into a short effect video
- Add a camera move to a still picture
- Create explosion, levitation or similar VFX from a picture
- Make quick stylised clips for social media
whenToUseAnother:
- Use Video Studio for free-form video generation from a prompt
- Use Cinema Studio for camera-driven shots with more control
- Use Image Studio to create or edit the source image first
- Use Storyboard to plan several scenes

chunks.title: VFX — Overview
chunks.text:
VFX (/studio/vfx-studio). Overview.
businessValue: VFX Studio produces eye-catching short clips from existing images without manual compositing.

chunks.title: VFX — How to use
chunks.text:
VFX (/studio/vfx-studio). How to use.
howToUse: Open VFX Studio from the studio list (/studio/vfx-studio). Add an image with the Add image square (or paste an image URL), pick an effect card in one of the category tabs, optionally type a short description of the subject, choose the four settings, then click Generate ✨. When the video is ready use Download or the other buttons beside it.
howToSteps:
- Open VFX Studio from the studio list. The page shows the AI VFX Studio banner, an input panel and, below it, the effect cards.
- Click the Add image square on the left of the input panel and choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image (you can also drag a file onto the square). Alternatively paste an https:// link ending in .jpg, .jpeg, .png or .webp into the …or paste an image URL (https://) and press Enter box and press Enter.
- Wait until the image shows in the square. The Remove image button (an x on its corner) clears it if you picked the wrong one.
- Choose a category tab: AI Effects, Motion Controls or VFX. Use Search effects... to find a card by name.
- Click an effect card. The panel then shows Effect: followed by the card name.
- Optional: type a short description in the box that starts with Optional: describe the subject (for example "a red sports car"). It is added on top of the effect.
- Choose Aspect, Duration, Size and Quality in the row under the input.

chunks.title: VFX — How to use
chunks.text:
VFX (/studio/vfx-studio). How to use.
- Click Generate ✨. A window titled Generating your video... shows progress; you can click Cancel in the input panel to stop.
- When the window says Your video is ready!, click Download to save the MP4, or Close to look at the result panel below the input.
- In the result panel you can click Copy URL, Post to social, Enhance, Regenerate (run the same settings again) or New Video (clear everything and start over).
gettingStarted:
- Open VFX Studio from the studio list.
- Add an image with Add image.
- Click an effect card in the AI Effects tab, for example Fire.
- Click Generate ✨ with the default settings (16:9 Landscape, 5s, 480p, Medium).
- Download the finished video.
tips:
- Use a clear, well-lit image where the subject is easy to see; the effect is applied to that image.
- Leave the prompt empty at first. The preset name already picks the look; add a prompt only to name the subject.
- The default settings (16:9 Landscape, 5s, 480p, Medium) are the quickest way to test an effect; raise Size and Quality for the final version.
- Choose 9:16 Portrait for vertical social videos.
- Use Search effects... if you know the name; the search filters the cards of the category tab you are on.
bestPractices:
- Test an effect at the default size, then regenerate at 720p and High quality once you like it.

chunks.title: VFX — How to use
chunks.text:
VFX (/studio/vfx-studio). How to use.
- Match Aspect to where the video will be used before generating, because it cannot be changed afterwards without regenerating.
- Keep the subject centered and uncluttered in the source image.
- Use Regenerate to retry the same settings, and New Video when you want a different image or effect.

chunks.title: Thumbnail Studio — Overview
chunks.text:
Thumbnail Studio (/studio/thumbnail-studio). Overview.
description: Creates YouTube-style thumbnails from a text description. Pick a style, a category template chip, a model, a canvas size and a quality level, then generate 1 to 4 variations. Every prompt is automatically extended with click-through-rate (CTR) cues. Includes an Edit image mode with an optional mask, a Refine last result step, a personal gallery and a community gallery.
shortDescription: Create YouTube-style thumbnails with automatic CTR cues, eight style buttons, ten template chips, size and quality presets, an Edit image mode, a personal gallery and a community gallery.
fullDescription: Thumbnail Studio turns a short description into thumbnails for YouTube and other platforms. On the generate tab you write what the thumbnail should show (or click a template chip such as Gaming or Tutorial), choose one of eight styles, a model, a canvas size and a quality level, and click Generate. Behind the scenes the studio appends a block of click-through-rate cues to your text (strong focal point, high contrast, emotional expression, room for text and similar). You can ask for 1 to 4 variations at once, switch to Edit image mode to start from your own picture with an optional painted mask, and use Refine last result to change the newest image. Finished images land in the mine tab, which is stored in your browser, and can optionally be shared to the community tab.

chunks.title: Thumbnail Studio — Overview
chunks.text:
Thumbnail Studio (/studio/thumbnail-studio). Overview.
bestFor: Creators and marketers who need click-friendly thumbnails quickly, with a few clicks and no design software.
whenToUse:
- Creating YouTube or social thumbnails from a text description
- Testing several thumbnail versions with VARIATIONS
- Starting from a template chip for a common video category
- Changing part of an existing picture with Edit image and a mask
- Looking at public thumbnails in the community tab for ideas
whenToUseAnother:
- Use Image Studio for general images and a wider choice of models
- Use Cinema Studio for cinematic stills
- Use AI Influencer Studio to design a consistent character
- Use Brand Studio for on-brand campaign creatives
businessValue: Gives creators a fast way to produce and compare several thumbnail options per video, which saves time compared with designing each one by hand.

chunks.title: Thumbnail Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Thumbnail Studio (/studio/thumbnail-studio). How to use.
howToUse: Open /studio/thumbnail-studio, type a description (or click a template chip), pick a style, model, canvas size and quality, then click the Generate button at the bottom. Results appear in the mine tab.
howToSteps:
- Open Thumbnail Studio from the studio list (route /studio/thumbnail-studio). The Generate tab is open by default.
- At the top, choose the mode: '✦ Generate' (text to thumbnail, the default) or '✎ Edit image' (start from a picture you upload). If you choose '✎ Edit image', add your picture in the REFERENCE IMAGE box ('Drop an image or click to upload'). Optionally click 'Add mask', then use 'Paint' and 'Erase' to mark the areas you want changed.
- In the DESCRIBE YOUR THUMBNAIL box, type what the thumbnail should show, for example 'A dramatic gaming thumbnail with a shocked face and bold text...'. The Generate button stays disabled until this box has text.
- Optional shortcut: click one of the template chips under the box (Gaming, Tutorial, Finance, Fitness, Food, Tech, Reaction, Vlog, Music, Education). A chip replaces the box content with a ready-made prompt that you can then edit.
- Optional: click the wand button inside the box (tooltip 'AI enhance prompt'). An 'Enhanced:' line appears under the box and is used instead of your raw text when you generate. Editing the box text clears the enhanced version.

chunks.title: Thumbnail Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Thumbnail Studio (/studio/thumbnail-studio). How to use.
- Under STYLE, click one of the eight styles: Cinematic (selected by default), Vibrant, Bold Text, Face Focus, Minimal, Neon Glow, Retro or Photorealistic.
- Under MODEL / API, check the model shown (GPT Image 2 by default). Click it to open the list, type in 'Search models' if you want, and pick GPT Image 2, GPT Image 1, DALL·E 3 or DALL·E 2.
- Under CANVAS SIZE, pick a size card (16:9 HD / YouTube HD is the first and the default). Under QUALITY, pick Draft, Standard (the default) or Best.
- Optional: click 'Advanced options' to set OUTPUT FORMAT (PNG, JPEG or WebP; JPEG is the default), COMPRESSION (shown for JPEG and WebP only), VARIATIONS (1, 2, 3 or 4) and the 'Share to community' switch (on by default).
- Click the large Generate button at the bottom. It reads 'Generate Thumbnail', or 'Generate 2 Thumbnails' (and so on) when VARIATIONS is above 1. A progress area shows the steps while MuAPI works.
- When the images finish, the studio switches to the 'mine' tab (shown as Mine) and your new thumbnails appear first. Hover over an image to reveal icon buttons: 'Download', 'Reuse settings', 'Make private' / 'Make public' and 'Delete'. Click an image to enlarge it.
- To tweak the newest result, go back to the generate tab, open 'Refine last result', type the change (for example 'Change the background to a dark cityscape...') and click 'Apply refinement'.

chunks.title: Thumbnail Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Thumbnail Studio (/studio/thumbnail-studio). How to use.
- Use the 'community' tab to browse public thumbnails for ideas and click 'Reuse settings' on one to load its prompt back into the Generate tab.
gettingStarted:
- Open /studio/thumbnail-studio and stay on the generate tab.
- Type a description in DESCRIBE YOUR THUMBNAIL, or click a template chip such as Gaming or Tutorial.
- Pick a STYLE, a CANVAS SIZE and a QUALITY level.
- Click the Generate button at the bottom.
- Review the result in the 'mine' tab and use 'Download' to save it.
tips:
- Start with a template chip, then edit the pre-filled text to match your video; it is faster than writing from scratch.
- Use VARIATIONS (under 'Advanced options') to get up to 4 versions in one click and compare them side by side.
- Use Draft quality while exploring ideas and switch to Best for the version you will publish.
- Pick the 16:9 HD or 16:9 size card for YouTube; 9:16 is labelled 'Shorts / TikTok' and 1:1 is labelled 'Instagram / square'.
- Use the wand button 'AI enhance prompt' when your description is short; check the 'Enhanced:' text before generating.
- Open the community tab for ideas and click 'Reuse settings' on any image to load its prompt and size back into the generate tab.
- Turn off 'Share to community' before generating if you do not want the images to appear in the public gallery.
bestPractices:

chunks.title: Thumbnail Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Thumbnail Studio (/studio/thumbnail-studio). How to use.
- Describe one clear subject, an emotion and a background; the studio already adds contrast and focal-point cues for you.
- Keep wording short and concrete; leave room in your description for the title text you will add later.
- Generate several variations and compare them at small size before choosing one.
- Download your favourites right away: the mine tab is stored only in this browser (up to 100 images) and is not a cloud backup.
- Use 'Refine last result' for small changes to the newest image instead of rewriting the whole prompt.

chunks.title: Thumbnail Studio — Problems and limits
chunks.text:
Thumbnail Studio (/studio/thumbnail-studio). Problems and limits.
- question: Where do I find Thumbnail Studio? | answer: Open /studio/thumbnail-studio, or pick Thumbnail Studio in the studio list.
- question: What is the CTR prompt engine? | answer: It is an automatic step: every time you generate, the studio adds click-through-rate cues (single focal point, high contrast, emotional expression, room for text) to your description. There is no switch for it.
- question: Which models can I use? | answer: The MODEL / API list offers GPT Image 2 (default), GPT Image 1, DALL·E 3 and DALL·E 2.
- question: How many thumbnails can I create at once? | answer: Open 'Advanced options' and choose VARIATIONS 1, 2, 3 or 4.
- question: What sizes are available? | answer: CANVAS SIZE offers 16:9 HD, 16:9, 1:1, 9:16, 4:3 and 2K. 16:9 HD is the default.
- question: Where are my thumbnails saved? | answer: In the mine tab, stored in your browser (the newest 100 are kept). Use 'Download' to keep a copy.
- question: Will my thumbnails be public? | answer: By default yes: 'Share to community' under 'Advanced options' is on, so new images are also saved to the public gallery. Switch it off before generating, or use 'Make private' on an image in the mine tab.
- question: Can I edit a picture I already have? | answer: Yes. Click '✎ Edit image', upload it in the REFERENCE IMAGE box, optionally paint a mask with 'Add mask', then describe the result and generate.

chunks.title: AI Influencer Studio — Overview
chunks.text:
AI Influencer Studio (/studio/ai-influencer). Overview.
description: Builds an AI character portrait by clicking picture tiles for face, body and style options (plus an optional text line) and generating an image of it.
shortDescription: Design an AI influencer or fantasy character by clicking picture tiles in a Builder panel, then generate and save the portrait.
fullDescription: AI Influencer Studio is a point-and-click character designer. The Builder panel on the left has three tabs (Face, Body, Style) with groups such as Character Type, Gender, Ethnicity / Origin, Eye Color, Hair / Head Growth and Rendering Style. Every group shows picture tiles and always has one tile selected. A toolbar above the preview lets you pick an aspect ratio (3:4, 1:1, 9:16 or 16:9), click 'Shuffle' for a random combination and click 'Generate Character'. You can add an optional line of extra details in the text bar at the bottom. Results show in the centre preview and pile up in the 'Generated' column on the right, where you can re-open them, save them or send them on.
bestFor: Creators who want to design a character by clicking options instead of writing a long prompt.
whenToUse:
- Designing a character or virtual influencer visually
- Exploring many looks with Shuffle
- Creating creature or fantasy character art
whenToUseAnother:
- Use Image Studio for free-form prompts and model choice
- Use Thumbnail Studio for YouTube thumbnails

chunks.title: AI Influencer Studio — Overview
chunks.text:
AI Influencer Studio (/studio/ai-influencer). Overview.
- Use Brand Studio for on-brand campaign visuals
businessValue: Lets non-designers produce character imagery quickly with a guided, click-based builder.

chunks.title: AI Influencer Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
AI Influencer Studio (/studio/ai-influencer). How to use.
howToUse: Choose one tile in each Builder group (or click Shuffle), pick an aspect ratio, optionally type extra details, then click 'Generate Character'. Click 'Save' to download the result.
howToSteps:
- Open AI Influencer Studio (route /studio/ai-influencer). The screen has three areas: the Builder panel on the left, the character preview with the toolbar in the centre, and a 'Generated' history column on the right.
- In the Builder panel use the three tab buttons at the top: Face, Body and Style. Each tab lists groups of picture tiles. For example Face has Character Type, Gender, Ethnicity / Origin, Eye Color, Eye Type, Eye Features, Mouth & Teeth, Ears, Horns and Skin Conditions.
- Click a tile in each group to choose it. One tile is always selected in every group (the first one by default) and the selected tile gets a check badge. There is no way to switch a group off, so look through every group on all three tabs, including Horns, Eye Features, Skin Conditions and Accessories & Markings, and pick the option closest to what you want.
- To start over, click 'Reset' at the top of the Builder panel; it puts every group back to its first option. To try a random combination instead, click 'Shuffle' in the toolbar above the preview.
- In the toolbar above the preview, choose the picture shape with the four buttons 3:4 (selected by default), 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9.

chunks.title: AI Influencer Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
AI Influencer Studio (/studio/ai-influencer). How to use.
- Optional: in the text bar at the bottom of the centre area, type extra details, for example 'neon cyberpunk lighting, dramatic shadows'. The placeholder reads 'Add extra details… e.g. neon cyberpunk lighting, dramatic shadows'. This text is added to the end of the prompt.
- Check the small pills above the text bar: they list your current choices (the first 7, then 'show more' / 'hide'). Hover over a pill to see its picture; click a pill to jump to the Builder tab that contains it.
- Click 'Generate Character'. The button shows 'Generating…' and the preview shows 'Generating your AI influencer…' while the image is made.
- When the image is ready it appears in the preview with buttons in its lower-right corner: 'Save' (downloads a .webp file), 'Post to social', a star button and 'Personalize'.
- Every result is also added to the 'Generated' column on the right (with a count such as '1 characters'). Click a thumbnail there to show it again in the preview. Hovering a thumbnail on a desktop screen reveals copy-prompt and copy-image buttons, a download button and the 'Post to social' and star buttons.
gettingStarted:
- Open /studio/ai-influencer.
- Click through the Face, Body and Style tabs and choose one tile in each group (or click 'Shuffle').
- Pick an aspect ratio (3:4, 1:1, 9:16 or 16:9).
- Click 'Generate Character'.
- Click 'Save' under the preview to download the image.

chunks.title: AI Influencer Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
AI Influencer Studio (/studio/ai-influencer). How to use.
tips:
- Click 'Shuffle' a few times to find a starting look, then adjust single groups.
- Remember a tile is always selected in every group; check groups such as Horns, Eye Features, Skin Conditions, Accessories & Markings and Hair / Head Growth, because their default options will be included in the prompt.
- Use the pills above the text bar to review all current choices at once; click a pill to jump to its group.
- Use the text bar for lighting, mood or background details that no tile covers.
- Pick 9:16 for vertical profile images and 16:9 for wide banners.
- Click 'Save' on results you like: the 'Generated' column is only kept while the studio is open.
bestPractices:
- Decide the character type, gender and rendering style first, then refine eyes, hair and details.
- Keep the extra-details text short and visual.
- Generate, review, then change one group at a time so you can see what changed.
- Save each result you want to keep before reloading the page.

It is a window (modal) titled Publish to social that opens on top of whatever studio you are in when you click a Post to social button next to a finished image or video. There is no /studio/social-publishing page: that old address now lands in Image Studio (/studio/image). The window has four steps shown at the top: Write, Thumbnail, Destinations and Review & Publish. It shows a Preview of the image or video on the right. Accounts are connected on the Destinations step (a Connect button opens the platform's authorisation page in a new tab), and the actual publish request is sent from that step with the Publish Now button. Video can go to YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and X; an image can go to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and X.

Social Publishing (/studio/image). How to use.
howToUse: Social Publishing is not a studio tab of its own. It is a window (modal) titled Publish to social that opens on top of whatever studio you are in when you click a Post to social button next to a finished image or video. Opened from Image Studio this is /studio/image; other studios open the same window from their own result buttons.
howToSteps:
- Make an image or video in a studio (for example Image Studio at /studio/image, Video Studio, VFX Studio, Storyboard or Motion Director).
- Click the Post to social button next to the finished result (in Image Studio it is a small round button that appears when you hover a generated image on a wide screen; in VFX Studio it is a labelled button beside Download; in Motion Director it appears after you export the film). The Publish to social window opens with the first step, Write.

chunks.title: Social Publishing — How to use
chunks.text:
Social Publishing (/studio/image). How to use.
- Write step: type what the post is about in Post topic (What is this post about?). Click Write Post to generate three copy variants, or use Improve, Tone, Length and Platform Optimize on the text. Use the tabs Master, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook to view copy per platform. Click Continue.
- Thumbnail step (optional): choose Recommended or Explore Ideas, pick a template or type a prompt, set Aspect Ratio, and click Generate. You can click Continue without making a thumbnail.
- Destinations step: click a platform tile (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads or X). Images show only the platforms that accept images.
- Click the Connect button for that platform; the platform's authorisation page opens in a new tab. Approve access, return and click Refresh to list the account. You can also paste a known account ID under Add account manually (account ID) and click Add.
- Tick the checkbox on each account you want to publish to. Click the arrow on an account card to open its settings (Privacy, Schedule, Tags, Location, and Alt text for images).
- Check the Selected destinations box, then click Publish Now. Each account shows a status (queued, uploading, processing, published or failed) in Publish status; a failed one has a Retry button.

chunks.title: Social Publishing — How to use
chunks.text:
Social Publishing (/studio/image). How to use.
- Click Continue to reach Review & Publish to see a summary of the media, thumbnail, copy and destinations, and the results. Close the window with Close or the X at the top right when you are done.
gettingStarted:
- Open a studio that makes images or videos, for example Image Studio at /studio/image.
- Generate something, then click its Post to social button.
- In the Publish to social window go to Destinations and connect an account with the Connect button for the platform.
- Tick the account and click Publish Now.
- Watch Publish status for published or failed.
tips:
- You can leave the window open while you authorise an account in the new tab; click Refresh afterwards to see it.
- Choose the platforms first on Destinations; the platform tile shows a dot when an account of that platform is selected.
- Press Esc or click outside the window to close it; your steps are kept for the current session of the page until you open it for another media item.
- Use Retry on a failed destination instead of publishing everything again.
- A video can go to every platform listed; an image only to the ones that accept images.
bestPractices:
- Check the Preview on the right to be sure the right media is selected before publishing.
- Publish to one account first to make sure the connection works, then to several.

chunks.title: Social Publishing — How to use

chunks.title: GO-Viral — Overview
chunks.text:
GO-Viral (/studio/go-ai-viral). Overview.
description: A browsable feed of AI image and video prompts collected from public X posts, with search, filters, a prompt detail window, and one-click sending of a prompt to another studio.
shortDescription: Browse a feed of viral AI image and video prompts, copy them, or send them straight to another studio.
fullDescription: GO-Viral shows a feed of AI image and video prompts discovered from public X (Twitter) posts. Each record keeps its original author, source link, preview and recommended model, and credits ImgLume as the curator. The studio has three views (Feed, Video Prompts, Academy), a left sidebar with search, sort, category, model, view and (for video prompts) availability and language filters, and cards that open a detail window with the full prompt. From a card or the detail window you can copy the prompt, open the original post, or send the prompt to another studio. GO-Viral is sold separately: accounts without it see a locked screen with an 'Unlock GO-Viral' button, and every other studio stays open. Browsing the feed itself does not use your MuAPI key.
bestFor: Creators who want proven prompt ideas and a quick route from a prompt to a studio.
whenToUse:
- Looking for prompt ideas
- Copying a prompt that worked for others
- Sending a prompt to Image, Thumbnail, AI Influencer, Marketing, Video or Cinema Studio

chunks.title: GO-Viral — How to use
chunks.text:
GO-Viral (/studio/go-ai-viral). How to use.
howToUse: Open /studio/go-ai-viral, browse or search the Feed, click 'View Prompt' on a card, then use 'Copy Prompt' or 'Open in Studio'.
howToSteps:
- Open GO-Viral (route /studio/go-ai-viral). If your account has not unlocked it, you see a locked screen titled 'GO-Viral is sold separately' with an 'Unlock GO-Viral' button instead of the feed; every other studio stays open.
- At the top of the studio, choose a view with the three buttons: 'Feed' (the default), 'Video Prompts' or 'Academy'. The header also shows how many prompts are in the feed (for example '120 prompts').
- To find prompts, use the Search box in the left sidebar (placeholder 'Search prompts, tags...' in Feed, 'Search video prompts...' in Video Prompts). In the Feed view the list updates about half a second after you stop typing.
- Narrow the list with the sidebar groups: 'Sort By' ('Newest first' or 'Oldest first'), 'Categories' (starting with 'All categories') and 'Recommended Model' (starting with 'All models'). In 'Video Prompts' view you also get 'Availability' ('With video + prompt', 'With video only', 'All prompts') and 'Source Language' ('All languages' or one language).
- Under 'View' in the sidebar, switch between the grid (tooltip 'Grid view') and the list ('List view') layouts. Scroll down to load more; the list loads in pages of 30 and ends with '— End of feed —'.

chunks.title: GO-Viral — How to use
chunks.text:
GO-Viral (/studio/go-ai-viral). How to use.
- On a card, click 'View Prompt' (or click the card itself) to open the 'Prompt Details' window. It shows the preview, the full prompt text, the original author, the recommended model, media type, categories and language.
- In the 'Prompt Details' window click 'Copy' (or 'Copy Prompt') to copy the prompt text; the button briefly shows 'Copied!'. Click 'Open on X' or 'View on X' to see the original post.
- To use the prompt in another studio, click 'Open in Studio' in the 'Prompt Details' window or 'Create This Style' on the card. A window titled 'Open in...' lists the studios you can send it to: for image prompts Image Studio, Thumbnail Studio, AI Influencer Studio and Marketing Studio; for video prompts Video Studio and Cinema Studio. Click one (or 'Cancel') and the studio opens with the prompt passed along.
- Optional: click 'View details' in the top-right corner of a card to open that item's own demo page, or click 'Personalize This Demo' to open the personalization window for it.
- In 'Video Prompts' view, the cards show a video preview. Click a card to open the 'Video Prompt' window with 'Open in Studio', 'View Details', 'Open Video' and 'Copy Prompt' buttons.
gettingStarted:
- Open /studio/go-ai-viral (unlock GO-Viral first if the locked screen appears).
- Browse the Feed or switch to 'Video Prompts'.
- Use the Search box and the sidebar groups to narrow the list.

chunks.title: GO-Viral — How to use
chunks.text:
GO-Viral (/studio/go-ai-viral). How to use.
- Click 'View Prompt' on a card and use 'Copy Prompt'.
- Or click 'Open in Studio', choose a studio in the 'Open in...' window and continue there.
tips:
- Use the Search box with a topic or a tag (the placeholder says 'Search prompts, tags...').
- Use 'Recommended Model' to see prompts written for a particular model; the detail window shows the same value.
- Switch to the list layout under 'View' to see more rows at once.
- In 'Video Prompts' view leave 'With video + prompt' selected to see only items that have both a video and a prompt.
- Check the 'Original Source' block in the detail window to credit the author when you reuse an idea.
- After 'Open in Studio', check the receiving studio's settings: GO-Viral packages the prompt, title, an aspect ratio and a preview image reference, and each studio uses only what it supports (Thumbnail Studio and AI Influencer Studio, for example, use the prompt text, AI Influencer Studio also the aspect ratio).
bestPractices:
- Start broad with a category, then add a search term.
- Read the full prompt in the detail window before sending it to a studio.
- Keep the original source link when you share or publish work inspired by a prompt.
- Pick the target studio that matches the media type: the 'Open in...' window offers image studios for image prompts and video studios for video prompts.

chunks.title: Photo Studio — Overview
chunks.text:
Photo Studio (/photo-studio). Overview.
description: Generates a square product photo from a category and a style preset, optionally starting from a product image link and optionally saved under one of your brands.
shortDescription: Pick a category and a style, optionally add a product image link, and generate a square product photo.
fullDescription: Photo Studio makes product photography. You choose one of six categories (E-commerce, Lifestyle, Food & Beverage, Tech & Electronics, Beauty & Fashion, Health & Wellness), then one of five style buttons in that category, optionally paste a product image URL, and click 'Generate'. The studio creates one square (1:1) image, shows it under 'Result' and keeps a history per brand. The brand drop-down at the top right chooses which brand the result is saved under and which brand's history is shown. Photo Studio lives inside the Brand Studio frame, with the same left menu, and needs SmartVideo GO access to generate.
bestFor: Sellers and marketers who need clean product photos in a chosen style.
whenToUse:
- Creating product photography
- Trying different photo styles for one product
- Saving product photos under a brand
whenToUseAnother:
- Use Brand Studio for campaign concepts and platform creatives
- Use Image Studio for free-form images
- Use Thumbnail Studio for thumbnails
businessValue: Produces styled product images without a photo shoot.

chunks.title: Photo Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Photo Studio (/photo-studio). How to use.
howToUse: Open /photo-studio, choose a category and a style, optionally paste a product image link, then click 'Generate'.
howToSteps:
- Open Photo Studio at /photo-studio (it opens inside the Brand Studio frame; you can also click 'Photo Studio' under 'Tools' in the left menu, or 'Photo Studio' under a brand). The page is titled 'Photo Studio' with the line 'Generate product photography with AI'.
- Optional: use the drop-down at the top right (it starts on 'No brand') to pick one of your brands. Picking a brand attaches your result to that brand and shows that brand's earlier photos under 'History'.
- Click a category button: E-commerce (selected by default), Lifestyle, Food & Beverage, Tech & Electronics, Beauty & Fashion or Health & Wellness. Each category shows its own five style buttons.
- Click one style button. You must choose a style: the 'Generate' button stays disabled until you do, and changing the category clears your style.
- Optional: paste the web address of your product photo into the box 'Product image URL (optional)'. It must be a link to an image that can be opened publicly.
- Click 'Generate'. The button shows a spinner while the photo is made; the studio checks for the result every 2 seconds for up to about 3 minutes.
- When it is ready, a 'Result' panel shows the photo. Click 'Download' to open the full image in a new browser tab, then save it from there.

chunks.title: Photo Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Photo Studio (/photo-studio). How to use.
- Scroll to 'History' (shown when a brand is selected) to see earlier photos for that brand with their style and category.
- Optional: click 'Personalize' next to the brand drop-down (it appears once there is a photo) to send the newest photo to the personalization window.
gettingStarted:
- Open /photo-studio.
- Click a category such as E-commerce.
- Click a style such as Studio White.
- Optionally paste a product image link.
- Click 'Generate' and then 'Download'.
tips:
- Choose the category first: the style buttons change with it.
- Use a clear, well-lit product picture for the 'Product image URL (optional)' field and make sure the link opens the image directly.
- Pick a brand in the drop-down if you want the photo saved under it and visible in 'History'.
- Try several styles of the same product to compare looks.
- The result is square (1:1), which suits product listings and social feeds.
bestPractices:
- Start without a product link to explore styles, then add your product image for the final shot.
- Use one category per product type so the style buttons fit.
- Download results straight away from the 'Result' panel.
- Keep the product link public: private or login-protected links cannot be read.

chunks.title: Brand Studio — Overview
chunks.text:
Brand Studio (/brand-studio). Overview.
description: Paste a website address to create a brand profile (Brand DNA) you can edit, then generate four campaign concepts and platform-sized creatives for that brand. Photo Studio is available from the same menu.
shortDescription: Create a brand profile from a website address, then generate campaign concepts and creatives for eight platforms.
fullDescription: Brand Studio is a small workspace with one flow. On the 'New Brand' page you paste a website address and click 'Analyze'; the studio fetches the page and creates a brand entry (it reads the site's title or site name and its description to fill Brand Name and Tagline). On the Brand DNA page you edit and save the brand's identity, voice, colors, fonts and imagery style. From there you click 'New Campaign', choose a goal and click 'Generate 4 Concepts'. On the campaign page you pick a concept and one or more platforms (Instagram Feed, Instagram Story, LinkedIn, Facebook Ad, X / Twitter, Web Banner, Email Header, YouTube Thumbnail) and click 'Generate Selected Assets'; the results are shown under 'Generated Assets'. A left menu lists your brands and links to 'Photo Studio'. Creating brands needs SmartVideo GO access.
bestFor: Agencies and small businesses that want on-brand campaign concepts and creatives from a website address.
whenToUse:
- Turning a website into a brand profile
- Generating campaign concepts for a goal

chunks.title: Brand Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Brand Studio (/brand-studio). How to use.
howToUse: Open /brand-studio, paste a website address and click 'Analyze', edit the Brand DNA and click 'Save', then click 'New Campaign', choose a goal, click 'Generate 4 Concepts', pick a concept and platforms and click 'Generate Selected Assets'.
howToSteps:
- Open Brand Studio at /brand-studio (choose 'Brand Studio' in the studio list). The page is titled 'New Brand'. A menu on the left (a row of buttons at the top on a phone) has 'New Brand', your 'Brands' and a 'Tools' group with 'Photo Studio'.
- Click in the box that shows the placeholder 'https://your-brand.com' and type or paste the full web address of the brand's website.
- Click 'Analyze'. Three progress lines appear in turn: 'Fetching website...', 'Analyzing brand identity...' and 'Saving brand DNA...'. When it finishes you land on the brand's Brand DNA page.
- On the Brand DNA page, review and complete the details. 'Core Identity' has Brand Name, Industry, Tagline, Value Proposition and Target Audience. 'Voice & Personality' has Tone of Voice, Personality and Key Messages. 'Colors' has Primary and Secondary colors. Below are Fonts and Imagery Style.

chunks.title: Brand Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Brand Studio (/brand-studio). How to use.
- To add an item to Tone of Voice, Personality, Key Messages or Fonts, type it in the 'Add...' box and press Enter or click the plus button; click the small x on an item to remove it. To add a color, pick one with the color box or type a six-digit hex value such as #1a2b3c, then click the plus button.
- Click 'Save' (top right). The button shows 'Saved' for a moment when your changes are stored.
- Click 'New Campaign' (top of the Brand DNA page, or under the brand in the left menu). Choose one goal card: Product Launch, Lead Generation, Brand Awareness, Engagement, Thought Leadership or Direct Sales. Optionally type extra guidance in the 'Optional creative direction...' box.
- Click 'Generate 4 Concepts' (it stays disabled until you choose a goal). When it finishes you land on the campaign page.
- On the campaign page, under 'Concepts', click the concept card you want (the first one is selected by default). Under 'Platforms', click one or more platform buttons: Instagram Feed, Instagram Story, LinkedIn, Facebook Ad, X / Twitter, Web Banner, Email Header, YouTube Thumbnail.
- Click 'Generate Selected Assets' (it shows how many platforms are selected, for example 'Generate Selected Assets (3)'). Each platform shows 'Queued...', then 'Generating...' and finally 'Done' or a 'Failed:' message; two platforms are worked on at a time.

chunks.title: Brand Studio — How to use
chunks.text:
Brand Studio (/brand-studio). How to use.
- When the run ends, your results appear under 'Generated Assets' as cards with the image, the platform name, a headline, body text and a call to action.
- To make product photos for the brand, click 'Photo Studio' under the brand in the left menu or at the top of the Brand DNA page; the brand is pre-selected there (see the Photo Studio guide).
gettingStarted:
- Open /brand-studio.
- Paste your website address into the box ('https://your-brand.com') and click 'Analyze'.
- On the Brand DNA page, fill in the details and click 'Save'.
- Click 'New Campaign', choose a goal and click 'Generate 4 Concepts'.
- Pick a concept and platforms, then click 'Generate Selected Assets'.
tips:
- Use the full address including https://.
- After 'Analyze', fill in the empty Brand DNA fields (Industry, Value Proposition, Colors and so on) and click 'Save': the campaign steps use the brand details you provide.
- Colors must be written as six-digit hex values such as #1a2b3c.
- Give a creative direction in the optional box when you have a specific angle in mind.
- Select only the platforms you need; each selected platform is a separate generation.
- Use the brand list in the left menu to jump back to an earlier brand.
bestPractices:
- Review and save the Brand DNA before creating a campaign.
- Choose a goal that matches the real objective (for example Lead Generation vs Brand Awareness).
